title: Any space ship fans out here? Browser game
author: BamBa1213
selftext:
Now this might not be the most impressive thing you've every seen, how ever I feel like the game is slowly getting it's own identity and vibe at this point.

  
And to be honest, I am here to get a sense of what the outside world thinks, as I am too much in my own bubble, although I have some amazing friends already playing the game on a daily basis and helping me along the way, which motivates me a lot!

  
This is an MMORPG inspired by EVE Online’s look and player-driven economy, with Albion Online’s combat, built in three.js. It’s fully playable in the browser (not open to the public yet) and built with the help of AI.

I have a lot of doubts developing this game (which I am doing 12 hours a day at this point), there are so many games being show-cased that are way more beautiful, but I am balancing what is beautiful vs having smooth big PvE and PvP battles with good performance.

  
Would this be something you’d click on or does it look cheap?

If you want to follow along or get into the upcoming play test, feel free to join the discord.  
[https://discord.gg/CVBYEGcjHK](https://discord.gg/CVBYEGcjHK)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/BamBa1213 could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.

comments.author: yukajii
comments.body:
oh how much I hate to be THAT guy...

I think the number one genre that anyone would advise against building as a solo/indie dev is an MMORPG. Especially a cosmic scale one with player driven economy. It takes years, teams of dozens and hundreds, and many-many millions of marketing budgets to make these properly, and then as much effort to maintain. And even then most fail.

On your question: the ships look pretty cool at this angle, even though they are very clearly code-generated and not proper 3d models, and UI is quite AI.

If you and your friends are having fun with it, hanging out in discord - that's awesome, cherish it! But also it's probably the best result you can achieve with it, I wouldn't hope for a commercial realization.

replies.author: BamBa1213
replies.body:
Maybe I am delusional trying to create something of this scope especially an MMORPG, people advice against it and I knew that going into this.

  
Although, I feel like with AI it has become more accessible than ever to create games, everyone and their grandma are developing something these days. And wiht that I think it has become more feasible, even if it’s still an intense amount of work.

And thanks for the honest feedback, that’s what I came here for. The ships are code-generated.  What makes the UI look AI to you? That’s what I’d like to fix first.

replies.author: yukajii
replies.body: I guess I'm used to seeing them. Probably the fonts and color palette
